about.title: Our Story
about.tagline: Real recipes. Real ingredients. Real good cake.
about.paragraph1: In 2012, Lety Gibbon started baking from her home kitchen in North West, using her Italian grandmother's handwritten recipe book. What began as weekend orders for friends and family quickly grew into something bigger — word spread about her lemon zest wedding cakes and honeycomb cupcakes.
about.paragraph2: Today, Mamma & Mia Cakes serves customers across Klerksdorp, Potchefstroom, Stilfontein, and beyond. Every cake is still hand-decorated by Lety. Every batch of cupcakes is baked fresh that morning. We source our butter, eggs, and honey from local North West farms.
about.paragraph3: We don't cut corners. We don't use premixes. When you order from Mamma & Mia, you're getting the same recipes Lety's grandmother perfected decades ago — made with care, delivered with a smile.

faq.question: How far in advance should I order a custom cake?
faq.answer: For custom cakes, we recommend at least 2 weeks' notice. For cupcakes or standard orders, 3-5 days is usually fine. For wedding cakes, we suggest booking 4-6 weeks ahead to secure your date.

faq.question: Do you deliver?
faq.answer: Yes, we deliver across the North West region — including Klerksdorp, Potchefstroom, Stilfontein, and Rustenburg. Delivery fees depend on the distance from our bakery. Pickup is also available.

faq.question: Can you accommodate dietary restrictions?
faq.answer: We offer gluten-free and vegan options for most of our cupcakes and cakes. Please specify your needs when ordering so we can adjust our recipes accordingly.

faq.question: Where are you located?
faq.answer: Our bakery is in North West. We provide the exact address upon order confirmation for pickup. We also deliver across the region.
